title: FIRST TIME TODAY
music: Sparse, tense investigative documentary underscore. Muted plucked strings and soft low piano pulse, slow 80 bpm, subdued and serious, no vocals, no drums build, steady bed for spoken narration.

segments.narration: Neptune Beach, Florida. City Manager Stefen Wynn picks a new water tank's color. Green in color is good.

sfx.prompt: single soft paper card slid across a wooden desk

segments.narration: Days later, he has the plans. Twenty-nine feet tall.

sfx.prompt: soft deep cinematic boom hit, short

segments.narration: The tank goes up behind people's homes. Neighbors call it the big green monster.

sfx.prompt: distant heavy construction crane and metal clank, brief

segments.narration: Wynn tells the council, the first time that I had seen the site plan was today.

overlays.text: “The first time that I had seen the site plan … was today.”
overlays.by: Wynn to the City Council, Dec. 9, 2022

segments.narration: As staff gather tank records for a public records request, he closes her door, and tells her to run them by him first.

overlays.text: Run anything about the tank by him, “so that he could decide whether it was okay to send.”

sfx.prompt: wooden office door closing firmly with latch click

segments.narration: Fired, unanimously. He sued, calling himself a whistleblower.

sfx.prompt: heavy rubber stamp pressed onto paper, single hit

segments.narration: October first, twenty twenty-six. A judge ruled against him. The city attorney, under oath: when it was shown that he picked the color, that was proven to be a lie.

overlays.text: “…when it was shown that he picked the color, that was proven to be a lie.”
overlays.by: Neptune Beach City Attorney, sworn deposition

sfx.prompt: single wooden judge gavel strike in a quiet courtroom

end.source: Wynn v. City of Neptune Beach, No. 16-2023-CA-008801 (Fla. 4th Cir. Ct.), Order Granting Summary Judgment, Oct. 1, 2026
